name: Toasts & unlock pop-ups
oneLiner: Achievement, quest-update and item-get notices slide in from a screen edge, stack and glide, leave on a visible timer line, merge duplicates into one card with a punching ×N badge (quest progress updates one card in place), and queue behind a "+N more" chip when more arrive than fit. They keep to a safe area, step around every HUD rect the game reports, hide while a window covers their place and come back after, and never pause the game or take input. Glassy cards on HD canvases, a crisp pixel card with its own bitmap fonts on native pixel canvases.
notFor: phase or result moments that should stop the player (use C-04 big banner)
dialogue, tutorials or anything the player must read in full (use H-01 dialogue box)
damage or heal numbers over units (use C-11 / E-01)
dozens of events per second from one source (merge keys help, but use a counter in the HUD)

needs: game events worth announcing (pickups, purchases, loot, quest steps, unlocks, level-ups, firsts), at the code that decides them
a fixed update step that runs in every scene, menus open included (also run by ?t= fast-forward)
the screen size in logical px (bounds)
the rects of the HUD panels, minimap, message lines, captions, banners and open windows on screen now
provides: non-blocking notices with merge, queue and auto-dismiss (busy() is always false)
rects() of the cards and chip, for other overlays to avoid
debug events (push, merge, enter, exit, hide, show, wait, drop) and stats() / state() for tests

assets: module/toasts.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Toasts): card layout, stack, springs, merge, queue, safe-area and UI-rect avoidance, smooth glass cards with vector icons, crisp pixel cards with built-in 5x7 / 3x5 bitmap fonts and 7x7 icons
no image, font or audio files (system sans stack, never loaded from the network)
